purpose: Provide one executable planning seam shared by P04 and P05 that separates host execution runtime from provider/external access, preserves sanitized inherited evidence, and prevents already-completed current-runtime work from being re-planned as local work.

capability_facts.rule: At most one hard host requirement may be true. Conflicting hard requirements mean the work unit is not atomic and must be split before placement.

provider_access_record.rule: Provider access is composable metadata and never substitutes for host execution environment.

rules: Tracked evidence must not contain raw private provider URLs or identifiers; sanitize them regardless of the claimed visibility label.
PROTECTED_EXTERNAL evidence must use an opaque tracked alias and keep the private identity in protected provider transport.
Freshness/revision and proof ceiling travel with the evidence reference.
Raw GitHub provider URLs are accepted only for PUBLIC_TRACKED evidence when public_provider_ref_verified=true; otherwise use an opaque alias.

placement_precedence: CURRENT_CHAT_RUNTIME when current_runtime_available and current_runtime_authorized are both true.
execution_rule: CURRENT_CHAT_RUNTIME is executable-now only when both current_runtime_available and current_runtime_authorized are true. All other host placements are handoffs or blocked/owner-resolution states for the active chat.

projection_rules.P04: Partition before dependency graph and adapter selection; emit placement after LAUNCH ORDER and preserve the typed fields in the dispatch manifest.
projection_rules.P05: Partition before ordered pack construction; LAUNCH ORDER remains first; already-completed current-runtime work becomes inherited evidence rather than a fake successor sprint.

privacy_rules: Reject raw Google Workspace URLs from tracked evidence regardless of the submitted visibility label.
Raw GitHub provider URLs require PUBLIC_TRACKED visibility plus public_provider_ref_verified=true; private or unverified GitHub identities must use an opaque alias.
PROTECTED_EXTERNAL evidence must use an opaque alias such as opaque:prompt-scratch/live-workbook.
Visibility metadata never declassifies a private provider identity; provider-private identity remains in protected external transport.

public_provider_ref_verified.rule: May be true only with PUBLIC_TRACKED visibility and only when the planner has independently verified that the provider reference is public.

proof_ceiling: Deterministic repository implementation and shared P04/P05 projection contract. P04 dispatch can recompute the projection before launch; provider authentication, prompt-model obedience, local runner availability, live runtime-tool dispatch, and P05 canonical-body adoption remain separately proven states.

already_executed_here.rule: May be true only when the selected host is CURRENT_CHAT_RUNTIME and inherited_evidence is non-empty; it means the active runtime has already completed the work and P04/P05 must preserve its evidence without emitting repeat execution or a fake successor handoff.

cli_surface.stdin_rule: Use --input - to read one WorkUnit JSON object from stdin.
cli_surface.nonzero_exit_rule: Malformed, conflicting, privacy-unsafe, or unsupported WorkUnits exit 2 and must not be projected.
